jobs_results.title: Analista de datos (sector aeronáutico)
jobs_results.description:
¿Te interesaría formar parte de un proyecto de digitalización dentro de uno de los clientes más punteros del sector aeronáutico?

En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo. Por eso nos comprometemos a impulsar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Te unes a nuestro #WelcomeHome? ¡Sigue leyendo!

¿Cuál será tu misión?
• Migración de procesos DOA / POA a la nube
• Procesos ETL
• Despliegue de apps y dashboards en google workspace

Requisitos:
• Ingeniero/a
• Experiencia con las herramientas Python, Workspace y/o Visual Basic
• Valorable experiencia en el sector aeronáutico
• Inglés medio

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?
• Incorporación a una empresa multinacional competitiva en continuo crecimiento.
• Integración en un equipo de profesionales altamente cualificado, con un buen clima laboral, innovador y dinámico.
• Formación especializada y desarrollo profesional continuo.
• Beneficios... Sociales y Plan de compensación flexible.
• Retribución competitiva.

¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que tenemos una facturación mundial de más de 2.900 millones de euros, contamos con 42.300 profesionales y estamos presentes en más de 30 países.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

Si crees que eres talento, ¡apúntate

jobs_results.title: Analista de Datos Junior (IBM Cognos y/o Power BI)
jobs_results.description:
Responsabilidades
• Crear y mantener informes corporativos utilizando IBM Cognos y/o Power BI para proporcionar análisis de datos precisos y oportunos.
• Desarrollar modelos de datos que permitan a los usuarios de negocio realizar informes personalizados según sus necesidades.
• Colaborar con diferentes equipos de la compañía para comprender los requisitos de datos y proporcionar soluciones técnicas que se adecuen.
• Diseñar y desarrollar nuevos cuadros de mando para la dirección general de FIATC, proporcionando una visión clara de los indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPIs) y métricas relevantes.
• Contribuir al diseño e implementación de nuevas fuentes de datos, métricas y KPIs para las diferentes áreas de la compañía.
• Participar de forma directa en el Gobierno del Dato de la compañía.

Requisitos
• Experiencia previa o conocimientos básicos en el uso de IBM Cognos y/o Power BI, u otras herramientas de BI.
• Conocimiento básico de SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
• Fuertes... habilidades analíticas y capacidad para interpretar datos complejos.
• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y en equipo en un entorno ágil y rápido.
• Persona con pasión por el dato, curiosa por naturaleza y que busque el desafío de aprender.

Si cumples con estos requisitos y estás interesado en unirte a nuestro equipo, ¡esperamos recibir tu solicitud

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
About MIGx

MIGx is a global consulting company with an exclusive focus on the healthcare and life science industries, with their particularly demanding requirements on quality and regulatory aspects. We have been managing challenges and solving problems for our clients in the areas of compliance, business processes and many others.

MIGx interdisciplinary teams from Switzerland, Spain and Georgia have been taking care of projects in the fields of M&A, Integration, Application, Data Platforms, Processes, IT management, Digital transformation, Managed services and compliance.

About the profile

We are looking for a data enthusiast who likes to play with structured and unstructured data, organize it and create useful dashboards for taking insights and value for it.

Project Description

We are working in several projects building Power BI dashboards that are to be powered by multiple data sources. You will be part of a bigger team in MIGx responsible for the Data Services and building... Data Products for our customers (mid to large size enterprises). You will have an opportunity to continue growing in the are of all things Data related. You will participate in building overall Data Mesh architecture for the customer while focusing on one specific visualization project and more upcoming.

Responsibilities
• To buid PowerBI dashboards
• To be able to configure and connect different data sources, in special, SQL databases
• To build data reports

Requirements - Must have
• Proficiency in Data Analytics and Data Visualization concepts
• 3+ years of practical experience with one of the reporting tools – Power BI (preferable).
• Skills in developing reports and dashboards
• Advanced SQL knowledge and background in relational databases such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, and PostgreSQL
• Understanding of landing, staging area, data cleansing, data profiling, data security and data architecture concepts (DWH, Data Lake, Delta Lake/Lakehouse, Datamart)
• Familiarity with Cloud technologies (Azure, AWS)
• Ability to work in an agile development environment (SCRUM, Kanban)
• Understanding of CI/CD principles and best practices

Requirements - Nice to have
• Experience in building ETL (Extract, Transform and Load) pipelines
• Experience with Azure Data Factory
• Experience with ADLSgen2

Languages
• English – B2 / C1

What we offer:
• Hybrid work model and flexible working schedule that would suit night owls and early birds
• 25 holiday days per year
• Possibilities of career development and the opportunity to shape the company future
• An employee-centric culture directly inspired by employee feedback - your voice is heard, and your perspective encouraged
• Different training programs to support your personal and professional development
• Work in a fast growing, international company
• Friendly atmosphere and supportive Management team

jobs_results.title: Analista SMO
jobs_results.description:
Desde NTT DATA, buscamos Analistas de Gestión de Servicios, que prestarán apoyo diario a la Oficina de Gestión de Servicios, realizando documentación e informes trimestrales y mensuales.

Las funciones principales serán:

- Apoyar los procesos y herramientas de gestión de servicios a través de un aseguramiento de la calidad adecuado.

- Establecimiento de cuadros de mando y creación de informes contractuales.

- Creación de documentación, plantillas y otros.

- Asegurarse de que toda la información se introduce correctamente en las herramientas de gestión de servicios.

- Seguimiento de los SQI y de las sanciones dentro del mes / asignación / incremento.

- Enumeración de todas las acciones cometidas dentro de las plataformas y garantizar la resolución de manera oportuna.

- Solicitud de embarque de entrada y salida y notificación de cambios a los equipos dentro del servicio.

- Gestionar las solicitudes de los diferentes tipos de accesos, para garantizar los permisos de dotación de... personal y las correcciones.

- Recopilación de actas y acciones dentro de ciertas reuniones, incluidos los arreglos y acciones de la reunión.

- Alinear las finanzas entre los proyectos e informar de los desajustes a los líderes.

Requisitos:

- Experiencia: 2+ años de experiencia como Analista de Reporting o puesto similar, preferiblemente con gestión de servicios de gobierno y ciclo de vida de gestión de servicios de TI.

Requisitos de habilidades:

- Titulación Universitaria

- Conocimiento avanzado de las herramientas de MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)

- Conocimiento avanzado de SharePoint

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita y verbal en inglés (C1).

- Capacidad para comunicarse en múltiples niveles, tanto internamente como de cara al cliente

- Conocimiento de Azure DevOps y ServiceNow. Cualquier experiencia de implementación o mejora en estos procesos/herramientas sería ventajosa

- Comprensión de modelos y procesos financieros

- La experiencia con ITIL sería ventajosa

- Experiencia trabajando con equipos remotos

- Experiencia en relación con clientes

Habilidades adicionales:

- Trabajo en equipo, proactivo, organizado y autónomo en el desempeño de funciones

- Analítico

- La asertividad es imprescindible

- Sólidas capacidades para llevar a cabo el día a día de los negocios

- Buenas relaciones interpersonales

jobs_results.title: ANALISTA DATOS IT
jobs_results.description:
Sobre La Empresa

Resa, Residencias de Estudiantes es la empresa líder en España en cuanto a gestión de alojamientos universitarios. Desde hace más de 30 años, desarrollamos y operamos residencias que se adaptan a las necesidades de los estudiantes. Contamos con la colaboración de las principales universidades españolas e internacionales. Miles de estudiantes confían en nosotros cada año. A día de hoy RESA cuenta con 41 residencias en 21 ciudades de España: A Coruña, Alboraia, Alcalá de Henares, Barcelona, Bilbao, Castelldefels, Donostia, Girona, Granada, Madrid, Málaga, Ourense, Pamplona, Salamanca, Sant Cugat del Vallès, Sevilla, Tarragona, Terrassa, Valencia, Vigo y Vitoria-Gasteiz y seguiremos creciendo con nuevos proyectos y aperturas.

Sobre El Rol De Analista De Datos

Buscamos incorporar a una persona en el departamento de IT, como responsable de:
• liderar el despliegue de la base de datos y analítica para mejorar la veracidad, calidad, procesamiento automático y análisis de... datos.
• Identificar y priorizar los casos de uso basados en las necesidades comerciales y la estrategia organizativa, evaluando la viabilidad técnica y el impacto de cada caso de uso

Descripción De Las Funciones
• Recopilar y limpiar datos de diversas fuentes para su análisis.(Zoho, SAP, Excel..etc)
• Extracción, transformación y carga de datos necesaria para el análisis
• Analizar grandes conjuntos de datos para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades.
• Desarrollar modelos predictivos y algoritmos utilizando técnicas de aprendizaje automático.
• Crear visualizaciones de datos claras y comprensibles para comunicar hallazgos.
• Elaborar informes detallados y presentaciones para los interesados internos.
• Colaborar con otros equipos para integrar soluciones de análisis de datos en los procesos empresariales existentes.
• Mantener y actualizar las bases de datos y sistemas de análisis de datos.

Protección De Datos Personales

Los datos personales que facilite en esta oferta, serán tratados por RESIDENCIAS DE ESTUDIANTES, S.L. con domicilio en Calle Serrano nº 41 4ª planta, 28001 Madrid (España) (en adelante, RESA), con la finalidad de gestionar su solicitud de candidatura en el presente proceso de selección. La base jurídica que legitima este tratamiento es la ejecución de medidas precontractuales. Sus datos se conservarán durante el plazo de 1 año. Si no desea que sus datos sean conservados durante este plazo podrá ejercer su derecho de supresión. Sus datos personales no serán cedidos a terceras personas salvo obligación legal.

Usted podrá ejercer en cualquier momento sus derechos de acceso, rectificación, oposición, supresión, limitación, portabilidad o revocar su consentimiento, dirigiendo una comunicación por escrito a la dirección postal indicada acreditando su identidad, identificándose como candidato y concretando su solicitud. Asimismo, en caso de considerar vulnerado su derecho a la protección de datos personales, podrá presentar una reclamación ante la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (www.aepd.es).

Requisitos mínimos

Requisitos
• Basado en Madrid o Barcelona
• Castellano e inglés hablado y escrito
• Al menos 2 años de experiencia trabajando como analista de datos
• Formación Académica: Grado superior en estudios relacionados con las tecnologías de la información
• Formación Complementaria en análisis de datos
• Habilidades técnicas: herramientas de análisis de datos, aprendizaje automático, manipulación de datos, lenguajes de programación, bases de datos, en concreto:
• Experiencia en el manejo de bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales.
• Dominio de Microsoft Power BI
• Conocimientos de procesos de ETL
• Conocimientos de SQL, Zoho Analytics y Python
• Capacidad para implementar y mantener soluciones de análisis de datos en entornos en la nube. (Azure)
• Deseable conocimientos de SAP (BW, Hana views…) y de infraestructura IT
• Conocimiento del Negocio: Industria hotelera y residencias de estudiantes
• Cualidades personales: pensamiento analítico, atención al detalle, curiosidad, capacidad de resolución de problemas complejos, trabajo en equipo y habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
• Compromiso con la precisión, la integridad y la ética en el manejo de datos

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Location: Spain/Portugal, hybrid or fully remote

Job Summary:

Our Regional Deployment Team is seeking a Healthcare Senior Data Analyst to analyse, map and ingest healthcare data into a data warehouse. The successful candidate will be responsible for deep understanding of clinical data sources and its related healthcare classifications/ontologies from various data sources, map it to target common data models, and ensuring the data is accurate and complete.

Responsibilities:
• Collect, organize, and analyse healthcare data from various sources, including electronic health records, claims data, and other sources.
• Ensure data accuracy and completeness by performing data quality checks and resolving data discrepancies.
• Ingest healthcare data into the data warehouse, ensuring data is properly formatted and optimized for analysis.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including healthcare professionals, IT, data engineers, and architects, to ensure data is properly analysed and... mapped.
• Lead in defining a data governance methodology and applying best practises to ensure that data is properly managed and secured.

Requirements:
• 5+ years of experience in healthcare data analysis, data warehousing, or related field.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex healthcare data sets.
• Familiarity with SQL, and other programming languages for data analysis.
• Experience with data of the medical domain
• General experience with Ontologies and Ontology crosswalks
• Experienced with the data exchange standards such as FHIR and other HL7 standards (v2.x, v3.x).
• Experienced with data governance and processes
• Knowledge of healthcare industry data standards and data models
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
• Comfortable to engage different healthcare professionals such as physicians, nurses, and other clinical professionals.
• Detail-oriented and organised, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible – to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

jobs_results.title: Client Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Being part of LOEWE gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

The job mission is to understand, structure and analyze large amount of data using specialized analytics tools as well as linking the data with the context, so to be able to profile Loewe client to detect and maximize business opportunities.

Your role will be:
• Exploit automated analytical tools to extract data from primary and secondary sources.
• Ensure the accuracy of the datasets to be analysed (data quality).
• Understand and follow-up how the Loewe client behaves, both in a quantitative and in a qualitative way, by staying informed on the market trends and working with the different markets and business areas within Loewe.
• Define and follow-up KPIs so that business performance and client behaviour can be assessed and compared over periods of time and between different markets, collections...
• Prepare... reports and presentations for the top management and for different stakeholders to share client insights and trends, using relevant client data.
• Support key stakeholders in the different regions and across different departments.

What is important for the role:
• Graduated in a STEM discipline (Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Economics, Biology, Biotechnology…). Master’s degree in Engineering, Data Analysis, Data Science, Big Data or related fields is highly appreciated.
• Savvy and curious about how trends, markets and fashion evolve both globally and locally, with a keen eye for cultural specificities.
• Minimum 1 year of experience in a data analysis role (including data visualization and data presentation, especially related to client behavior).
• Great attention to detail and feeling for the numbers.
• Previous experience in consultancy, Power BI and/or SQL is a plus.
• A team player committed to the team’s needs.
• High level of both Spanish and English with excellent communication and presentation skills.
• Comfortable in the adoption and usage of new tools and technology.

About us:

Created in Spain in 1846, LOEWE approaches 175 years as one of the world’s major luxury houses. Since 2013, under LOEWE’s creative director, Jonathan Anderson, the brand has started a new chapter, presenting itself to the world as a house focused on craft and culture; evidenced through an intellectual yet playful approach to fashion, bold and vibrant Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched expertise with leather.

LOEWE has a rich legacy of craftsmanship dating back to its beginnings as a collective workshop and has long valued artisanal techniques in its approach to design and manufacture. These core values are reflected in the brand’s belief in the importance of craft in today’s culture, its modern interpretations of historical artistic achievements and its commitment to supporting contemporary art, craft and culture around the world.

If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations Analytics
jobs_results.description:
This role is hybrid (2 days per week) in our Barcelona office

Who we're looking for:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Operations Analyst at Rover who is excited about independently owning complex, cross-functional projects from end to end. You will partner with senior business leaders on high visibility projects, relentlessly pursuing outcomes that directly influence the customer experience on the Rover platform. You will be seen as a thought leader on the team and across the organization, and should be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in identifying and solving business problems.

We want someone who is passionate about directly shaping Rover’s support experience. You should be excited about partnering with product and business leaders to identify problems in the support experience and generate solutions that scale with the business. You will be responsible for designing robust tests and sophisticated analyses that deliver strong, actionable... recommendations to improve our business. Examples of this include developing our strategy for multi-language global support, improving our self serve support experience, optimizing agent processes and workflows, assessing and improving how we measure support quality, etc.

In addition to concurrently driving several high impact cross functional projects, this person will also be responsible for creating new metrics to understand the performance of new business initiatives, developing reporting dashboards, and building data abstractions in DBT. Additionally, they will play a vital role in supporting AB testing and experimentation efforts, using statistical analysis to evaluate changes and drive meaningful change across the business.

Your Responsibilities:
• Partner with business leaders to identify and size problem areas, conduct deep and comprehensive analyses to better understand the problem and recommend solutions.
• Partner with our Operations Scalability product team to find opportunities to improve our customer experience and reduce our support costs through improving agent efficiency
• Develop strategies to both measure and optimize the organization’s efficiency, agent performance, and interactions with customers
• Serve as strategic partner and advisor to business leaders, responsible for making recommendations on investments and optimization strategies in key functional area
• Help build the team by mentoring junior team members on data manipulation and business partnering
• Support the construction of our reporting abstractions (built in dbt)

Your Qualifications:
• At least 6 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
• You are extremely comfortable with taking ambiguous issues and structuring them into crisp business problems, and using those to develop and execute on a refined project plan with clearly identified deliverables, all with relative autonomy.
• Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists
• You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
• You can independently prioritize projects based on return on investment and own the end-to-end project management for our analytics deliverables
• You are excited to help build a team and mentor junior analysts

Nice to have:
• Masters degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
• Ability to code in Python/R is a plus
• Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
• Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design

Benefits of working at Rover:
• Competitive compensation
• Permanent contract
• Pension Plan
• Meal tickets through Cobee
• Generous PTO Allowance
• Private health insurance
• Discounted Gym Membership
• Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
• Monetary help for adopting a dog plus yearly credit to use on our platform
• Flexible work hours, sometimes you’ll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we’re pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
• Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
• Regular team activities, including happy hours, game nights, and more

Who we are:

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

We believe everyone deserves the unconditional love of a pet—and at Rover, our mission is to make it easier to experience that love. Founded in 2011, the Rover app and website connect dog and cat parents with loving pet sitters and dog walkers in neighborhoods across the US, Canada, and Europe. We empower our community of trusted pet sitters and dog walkers to run their own pet care businesses on Rover with the tools and security of a global company to back them.

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, we work closely with our teams in Barcelona, San Antonio, Spokane, and remote locations. We’ve got a reputation for being a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. We're an agile, fast-growing company, and our leadership comes from some of the world's most respected tech companies.

At Rover, our furry coworkers are just as important as our human ones—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. Along with making the joys of pet parenthood more accessible, we’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming community of pet people—and that starts with our employees
